Weekly Rotation (Sept. 26th) - New Ranked Season 14 begins!
Vector, the Newest Legend, Joins Brawlhalla!
Weekly Rotation (Sept. 11th) - Don't Miss the Back to School Event!
Weekly Rotation (September 4th) - The Back to School Event is in full swing! We also updated the Brawl of the Week, changed items on sale, and updated the Legends on the free-to-play Legend Rotation!

School's in session with the Back to School Event in Patch 3.48! New exclusive Skins for Fait and Lin Fei, Home Team Colors, and more. We also added a test feature, made a balance pass, and a few other updates.
news.summary: Back to School event · 17 balance changes · 4 bug fixes

news.title: Weekly Rotation (August 21st) - Celebrating the Brawldown with WWE in Valhalla! We also changed the Legends on the free-to-play Legend Rotation and updated items on sale.
Weekly Rotation (August 14th) - The WWE Superstar Event continues! The new game mode, Brawldown, is featured as Brawl of the Week. We also updated the Legend Rotation and changed items on sale!
Play as WWE Superstars in Brawlhalla in Patch 3.47! Additionally, we've made a balance pass, game improvements, bug fixes, and more!
Weekly Rotation (July 31st) - Catch the Heatwave Summer Event and Summer Championship 2019 items before it's too late! We also updated the Brawl of the Week, changed items on sale, and more!
Weekly Rotation (July 24th) - Heatwave rolls on with a new Legend Rotation and updated sale items! We're also celebrating the 2019 Summer Championship with limited time items in Mallhalla!
Our Heatwave Summer Event rolls in for Patch 3.46! We also have new Summer Championship items for a limited time, Petra's price has been reduced, a balance pass, and so much more!
news.summary: Heatwave event · 12 balance changes · 8 bug fixes

news.title: Weekly Rotation (July 10th) - We've updated the Brawl of the Week to Platform Kings, changed items on sale, and more!
Weekly Rotation (July 3rd) - New Ranked Season 13 is here! We also updated the Brawl of the Week to Ghost Brawl, changed items on sale, and more!
Petra, the newest Legend, has been set free from Terminus and has her eyes set on Valhalla in Patch 3.45! We've also improved our daily missions for more customization, new test features, and more!
Weekly Rotation (June 19th) - The fun never ends with Adventure Time in Valhalla! We're continuing the celebration by featuring the new Buddy game mode as BotW, bonus login Gold, and more!
What time is it? Adventure Time in Valhalla for Patch 3.44! New Epic Crossovers, new Buddy game mode, and more! Additionally, we've added a balance pass, made some game improvements, and more.
Weekly Rotation (June 5th) - We've updated the Brawl of the Week to Platform Kings, changed items on sale, and updated the Legends on the free-to-play Legend Rotation!
Phase Four of Cross-play Rollout!
Sword of the Raven available on ALL platforms! Patch 3.43 also includes a feature where Crossovers no longer require using the base Legend, new cosmetic items in Mallhalla, and more!
Weekly Rotation (May 22nd) - Last week for the Championship Event! We also updated the Brawl of the Week to KO Mania, items on sale, and the Legend rotation.
Weekly Rotation (May 15th) - We're continuing the MTN DEW AMP GAME FUEL Championship Event with the first free earnable Taunt, earnable Colors, and more!
Celebrating the MTN DEW AMP GAME FUEL Championship Event! Patch 3.42 brings the first ever free earnable Taunt, earnable Colors, localization on PS4 & Xbox One, new test features, and much more!
Weekly Rotation (May 8th) - Last week for the 2019 Spring Championship items! We've also updated sale items in Mallhalla and changed the Legend Rotation!

Weekly Rotation (May 1st) - We would like feedback on the new server region, Japan! Also, this is your last chance for 2019 Spring Championship items. We also changed items on sale and updated the Legend Rotation!
A new region, Japan, debuts! Patch 3.41 also includes new Skins for Artemis and Kaya, 2019 Spring Championship limited-time items, Dragon's Chest, updated test features, and more!

Weekly Rotation (April 17th) - Ancient Chest has surfaced with exclusive Skins for Gnash, Ember, and Queen Nai! We're also continuing the Hellboy Epic Crossover event, updated the Legend Rotation, and items on sale!

Patch 3.40 - Hellboy joins Brawlhalla! The Epic Crossover Event includes a new Game Mode, Podium, and more! Additionally, Thor debuts on the Legend Rotation, we added a balance pass, made improvements, and more!
news.summary: Hellboy crossover · 14 balance changes · 14 bug fixes

news.title: Weekly Rotation (April 3rd) - New Ranked Season 12 starts today! We've also updated Brawl of the Week, new items on sale, and the Legend Rotation!
Weekly Rotation (March 27th) - Outlaw Chest is here with exclusive Skins for Caspian, Asuri, and Hattori! We're still celebrating the Luck o' the Brawl, updated the Brawl of the Week, and more!

Weekly Rotation (March 20th) - The new Forgeborne Chest arrives! We're still celebrating Luck o' the Brawl with exclusive event items for a limited time. We've updated the Brawl of the Week, items on sale, and more!
Register for the Spring Championship!
Patch 3.39 - Thor, God of Thunder, joins the battle! We're also celebrating Luck o' the Brawl with two new Skins, added Korean as a language option on PC, made bug fixes, and more!
Weekly Rotation (March 6th) - The Royal Order Chest appears with exclusive Skins! We're still celebrating the Enchantress Epic Crossover with bonus Gold, Strikeout Mania, and more!

Patch 3.38 - The Enchantress ascends as a new Epic Crossover! We're celebrating with bonus login gold, Fait also debuts on the Legend Rotation, Russian is a new language option, balance pass, and more!
news.summary: Enchantress crossover · 12 balance changes · 12 bug fixes

news.title: Weekly Rotation (February 20th) - International Winter Championship is this weekend! We also updated the Brawl of the Week, have new sale items, and more!
Register for Final Round in Atlanta, GA!
Patch 3.37 - Happy Valhallentine's! New Skins for Zariel & Ada, new Podium, Celestial Chest rotates in, updated Doodle Avatars, & more!
Brawlhalla Winter Championship is LIVE!
Register for the Winter Championship!
Weekly Rotation (February 6) - We'd appreciate feedback for the first roll out of our language options! We also updated the Brawl of the Week, new sale items, & more!
Patch 3.36 - Fait, the Star Speaker, joins Valhalla! We've also added items celebrating our upcoming Winter Championship, updated language settings, test features, balance, & more!
Weekly Rotation (January 23rd) - Sunken Chest has surfaced! We've also changed the Brawl of the Week to Team Strikeout, updated sale items, and more!
Patch 3.35 - Escape from Terminus, featuring our newest Epic Skin, Shin Sekai Koji! Also, new Skins for Val & Cross, new KO Effect, gameplay improvements, & more!
Weekly Rotation (January 9th) - Try your best in Double Frost! Also, new sale items in Mallhalla and an updated Legend Rotation!
Weekly Rotation (January 2nd) - Cosmic Chest has arrived! We also changed the Brawl of the Week, updated the Legend Rotation, & more!
